group_note: Six questions grouped on structure "plain", and all six are single-fact recall items answered by naming one thing, so demand is recall and structure single_step throughout - no member needs a verdict on every option, and none has a step that depends on another step's result. One member does not belong with the rest on E1: 2015_A#q083 is pair_options, because each option is two gas formulae taken or rejected whole, and so its format is pick_both_parts. One more differs on format alone: q080's options are rival mechanisms filling a "due to" slot, which is pick_cause_or_effect, while q079's causal stem is answered by a single substance name and so stays name_or_identify - that line is recorded in both notes. Elimination is granted to all six, but only on a fact separate from the answer that strikes out named options: pigments are not nodule proteins (q079), passive immunity is not a response the patient mounts (q080), calcium carbonate holds no nitrogen (q081), the aleurone layer is not in the embryo sac (q082), carbon monoxide forms no acid (q083), a sheath is not a cotyledon (q084). The trap axis is where the members were held level, because every wrong option in this packet is a true fact about something else, and the labels are split by how far away that something is: other_one_fact where it is another member of the same family (another haem protein, another arm of acquired immunity, another animal's waste form, another part of the same grain), and neighbouring_fact where the family itself differs (a chloroplast pigment against a nodule protein, innate against acquired immunity, smog against acid rain). Two wrong options break that pattern and are labelled differently: q081 option 1 carries no nitrogen at all, which makes it no_derivation_route demonstrated by the stem's own word "nitrogenous", and q083 option 3 holds one genuine acid-rain species beside one inert gas, which is half_true with the failing half named. No trap is placed on any official answer.
